mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses equity discount rates through lower risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a 20-day SPX return predictor remains below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or average 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS < 1.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 5.0% triggers central bank tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day SPX returns when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances or interaction term coefficient is insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), declining unemployment signals labor market tightening that accelerates monetary policy expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day SPX returns when UNRATE < 4.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in this regime.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly industrial production growth rate above 1.0% indicates expanding manufacturing output and corporate capacity utilization, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as a 5-day SPX return predictor remains below 0.03 in any 3-year window or average 5-day returns when INDPRO growth > 1.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0% (annualized) signals robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings visibility, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 60-day SPX returns when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%) signal active monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days through reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: Interaction term between CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS is insignificant (p > 0.05) or average 20-day returns when both conditions hold are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong job growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month) signals sustained economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day SPX returns when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in this regime.
